member.summary: This will throw if the method was not decorated with and the asking agent is unelevated.
member.remarks:
This method will be invoked if unelevated access attribute is not present on the method or class of the publishing object. That means, if the publishing agent is elevated and the asking agent is unelevated we will always throw access denied. if the elevated agent wants the unelevated agent to access the method they will decorate the method or class with the attribute which will ensure that this method is not invoked.
In this method we will always ensure to do something only if the publishing agent is elevated. An unelevated agent need not try to protect its API's.
